{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where they undershoot the true bottom",
    "When sentiment turns negative (0.00), model predictions are too slow to react, showing delayed price floor support",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes overshooting when prices are at extreme levels relative to sentiment momentum",
    "High sentiment (1.00) regions show model predictions that are 2-4 points too high, lagging the true price pullback",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to zero marks the start of a price consolidation phase that model doesn't capture early enough",
    "When price history shows a clear downtrend with flat sentiment, model maintains inflated forecasts while prices actually bottom and consolidate",
    "Model fails to recognize sentiment-driven price compression zones where prices oscillate around 75-76 range"
] }
